title: Eng hiring + onboarding sync — 2026-05-26
body:
Date: 2026-05-26
Location: Zoom / #eng-hiring Slack channel
Owners: Aisha Khan (owner), Ethan Park (interview loop lead)
Attendees: Aisha, Ethan, Maya, Diego, Priya, hiring-admin (notes)

Purpose:
Weekly sync covering interview debriefs, onboarding status for recent hires, open reqs, and team health flags. This is an operational working doc — rough notes and action items.

1) Quick hiring pulse
- Total open reqs (platform engineering): 6 active (3 backend, 1 infra, 1 SRE, 1 TPM).
- Candidates in loop this week: 5 (3 moved forward, 2 paused).
- Pipeline risk: slow scheduling for backend role due to interviewer capacity (primary cause: PTO + oncall).

2) Interview debriefs (summary + recommendation)
- Candidate: Backend Eng (Cand-2026-081) — loop on 2026-05-24
  - Interviewers: Ethan (system design), Maya (runtime), Diego (coding)
  - Notes: Strong system decomposition, good latency/cost tradeoff thinking, weaker on async debugging patterns. Completed take-home focused on KV-cache eviction strategy — solid but some edge-case gaps.
  - Score: 7/10
  - Recommendation: Move to final-round with senior backend (Priya) and hiring manager. Ask targeted follow-up on async debugging and observability.
  - Action: Ethan to schedule final-round by 2026-05-28.

- Candidate: Infra Site Reliability (Cand-2026-089) — loop on 2026-05-23
  - Interviewers: Diego (SRE), Priya (infra), external contractor (availability)
  - Notes: Deep SRE experience, clear runbook/workflow examples, strong incident postmortem culture. Concern: limited exposure to GPU infra and model-serving specifics (quantization/VM live migration).
  - Score: 8/10
  - Recommendation: Move to offer but include a 30–60 day ramp plan to cover GPU infra gap; hiring manager to confirm if this is acceptable.
  - Action: Priya to draft ramp-plan bullet list for offer package by 2026-05-29.

- Candidate: Senior TPM (Cand-2026-095) — loop on 2026-05-25
  - Interviewers: Maya, Hiring Manager (product), Eng leads
  - Notes: Excellent cross-functional program experience, strong roadmap/OKR alignment, concerned about capacity to lead multiple concurrent infra migrations.
  - Score: 6.5/10
  - Recommendation: Keep in loop but add a targeted exercise on multi-project prioritization; hold decision pending hiring manager calibration.
  - Action: Hiring manager to schedule an alignment call with Eng leads by 2026-05-30.

- Candidates paused: Two junior backend candidates (Cand-2026-076, Cand-2026-080) — paused due to competing offers and candidate timeline mismatch. Recruiting to re-engage next quarter.

3) Onboarding sync — new hires & progress
- New hires since last sync:
  - Nisha Kapoor (Backend Eng) — start 2026-05-11
    - Status: Laptop provisioned, M1 -> migrated to required GPU instance access, completed security training, first-week rotations scheduled with Maya.
    - Blockers: KMS access delayed (IT ticket #4521).
    - Action: Aisha to follow with IT and escalate if not resolved by 2026-05-28.

  - Omar Wallace (SRE) — start 2026-05-18
    - Status: Completed oncall shadowing schedule, granted production read-only access, paired with Diego on runbooks.
    - Blockers: PagerDuty escalation policy mapping needs review (owner: SRE lead).
    - Action: Diego to review escalation mapping by 2026-05-29.

- Onboarding checklist (current team standard):
  - Admin: equipment, access (Okta, GCP projects, KMS), payroll, badge — most completed within 3 business days for recent hires; continue to track KMS/account edge cases.
  - Technical ramp: 30/60/90 plan, mentor/buddy pairing, first 1:1 cadence (weekly x4).
  - Learning: runtime primer doc, dev env setup guide, perf benchmarks doc (links in Confluence).

4) Team health and signals
- Morale: generally stable; two engineers reported higher load due to interview loop + oncall. We need to protect maker time.
- SRE/oncall pressure: Current rotation has 1 person out on PTO next week which will increase load on others. Recommend temporary oncall swap and limit major releases.
- Knowledge gaps: GPUs/model infra experience remains a recurring ramp item — consider 1-day internal workshop on model-serving specifics (quantization, KV caching) next sprint.
- Headcount note: We are within hiring plan but timing is the risk. Hiring velocity slowed by ~10% due to interviewer availability.

5) Operational items / backlog that intersect hiring/onboarding
- Update onboarding checklist to include KMS approval flow (owner: Aisha) — target update 2026-06-02.
- Create a 1-day internal GPU-infra workshop script and materials (owner: Maya + Applied ML) — draft by 2026-06-04.
- Interviewer calibration session for backend loop to reduce scheduling churn and unify feedback rubric (owner: Ethan) — schedule during next all-hands week.

6) Action items (owner / due date)
- Ethan: Schedule final-round interview for Backend Eng Cand-2026-081 — due 2026-05-28.
- Priya: Draft 30–60 day ramp-plan for Infra SRE candidate if we extend offer — due 2026-05-29.
- Aisha: Follow up with IT on KMS ticket for Nisha — due 2026-05-28.
- Diego: Review PagerDuty escalation mapping with Omar — due 2026-05-29.
- Maya + Applied ML: Draft GPU-infra workshop materials — due 2026-06-04.
- Ethan: Run interviewer calibration session proposal and share rubric — due 2026-06-07.
- Hiring admin: Re-engage paused junior candidates next quarter — owner: hiring-admin — due 2026-08-01.

7) Notes to self / open questions
- Do we want to explicitly include a GPU-onboarding checklist for new hires that touch model-serving? (pro: reduces ramp, con: additional doc maintenance)
- Can we add a fixed weekly 30-min window for interview scheduling to reduce cross-team calendar churn?

8) Meeting cadence
- Continue weekly syncs (Tuesdays 10am PT). Next sync: 2026-06-02.

References / Links:
- Confluence hiring playbook: CONFLUENCE-ENG-HIRING-12
- Hiring pipeline board: JIRA-ENG-457
- Onboarding checklist (internal): https://confluence.redwood-inference.internal/onboarding/platform-eng

End of notes.
summary: Weekly hiring + onboarding sync covering interview debriefs (3 candidates moved/paused), onboarding status for two new hires, team health flags (oncall pressure, GPU knowledge gaps), and action items to unblock KMS access, schedule final interviews, and draft GPU workshop materials.
